summary.headline: 企业身份可确认，但「实际供货主体」「收款账户」「授权链」三处尚未闭环
summary.text: 公开信息可确认存在一家名为 Arabian Petrochemical Company（PETROKEMYA）的沙特石化企业，其为 SABIC 全资子公司，生产装置位于朱拜勒（Al Jubail），SABIC 官方产品目录列有 MEG 产品。但本次拟采购的合同主体、实际生产主体与收款主体尚未由供应商以正式文件对齐，且沙特官方商工部（Ministry of Commerce）登记系统在本次核验环境下无法直连查询。因此本报告不给出「风险分数」，也不认定其资金实力或履约能力，仅列出已确认事实、疑点与待索取文件。
key_findings: PETROKEMYA 的名称、归属（SABIC 全资）与朱拜勒装置在 3 个相互独立的公开来源中一致（E01、E04、E05）。
SABIC 官方产品页列有 SABIC® Monoethylene Glycol，并说明 MEG 主要用于 PET 与防冻液，产品能力与该采购品匹配（E02）。
SABIC 于 2026 年 3 月底曾就 EG 等产品发布不可抗力声明，中国方向沙特 MEG 到港量 2026 年 10 月约 12 万吨，供应处于恢复期（E08、E09、E10）——这是「当前供货能力」的关键时点事实。
本次演示中的报价单（PI）与银行收款信息均为**模拟件**，不代表任何真实企业曾向我方报价或提供文件（见 F01、F02、F03）。
商工部商业登记（CR）号码核查、清关许可、银行账户名核对三项未能完成，标注为「未知 / 未核实」。
not_concluded: 不认定真实产能、可用于本批次的可用量或发货计划；

blocks.text: 本批次采购的时点含义：MEG 供应正在从 2026 年上半年的中断中恢复，现货与到港量回升意味着卖方履约压力下降，但也意味着此时议价窗口与舱位安排比「谁真有工厂」更关键。公开信息只能说明产能存在，不能说明分配给我方的吨位存在。

优先使用 L/C 或预付比例受控的付款结构；散装 MEG 可考虑装港检验（SGS/Intertek）。
B/L、CO、发票、装箱单、COA 四方主体与批号对齐后才安排尾款。

rfi.title: Supplier Due-Diligence Enquiry — Monoethylene Glycol (MEG)
rfi.to: The Authorised Representative of Arabian Petrochemical Company (PETROKEMYA) / SABIC
rfi.intro: We are conducting pre-qualification checks ahead of a prospective purchase of fibre-grade monoethylene glycol. Please reply in writing on company letterhead, signed by an officer with authority to bind the company, attaching the documents listed. Replies from e-mail domains other than your official corporate domain will not be accepted as binding.

clauses.text: Confirm the full legal name, commercial registration (CR) number, address of the registered office, and legal form of the contracting entity, and attach a scan of the CR certificate.
Identify the exact entity that will issue the commercial invoice and the bill of lading as shipper, and state its relationship to the contracting entity.

If payment is to be made to an entity other than the contracting party, provide a signed payment instruction on company letterhead, a bank confirmation letter from the receiving bank, and a declaration of the relationship between the two entities.
Identify the production site(s) (plant name, city, country) from which the goods supplied under this contract will originate, and attach the industrial licence covering those products.
State the annual and monthly nameplate capacity for fibre-grade MEG at the producing site, and the volume earmarked for this enquiry with indicative loading windows.
Provide the TDS for the grade offered, including purity, diethylene glycol content, colour (APHA) and water content specified limits.
Provide a batch-level COA for a recent production batch of the same grade, on the producer's letterhead, showing test methods and results.
Provide the current SDS (revision number and date) for MEG issued by the producer named on the COA.
Confirm packaging and transport mode (bulk vessel, ISO tank, drum or flexitank) and, for bulk, the nominated load port and vessel/space arrangements.
Provide copies of valid management-system certificates (e.g. ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) with certificate numbers and issuing bodies.
Provide two recent bills of lading (redacted) for MEG shipments to confirm actual export performance and shipper identity.
Confirm whether any sanctions, export restrictions or force majeure currently affect your ability to perform, and describe any such measure with dates.
Provide an ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) declaration and any group structure chart showing the chain from the contracting entity to its ultimate parent.
Confirm the proposal's validity period, delivery terms, governing law and dispute-resolution venue to be used in the contract.

dos: 先识别主体，再查产品：把「集团有 MEG」「这家公司有 MEG」「这批货来自这家公司」拆成三件事分别取证。
用官方或监管来源锚定身份；二手来源只作线索，不直接升级为「已核实」。
收款主体不一致时停下来要文件，而不是继续往下走。
所有「未知」都给出补件动作，让核验结果可被下一位同事接手。
donts: 不要根据官网宣传认定真实产能、资金实力或履约能力。
不要在证据不足时给出风险分数或「低风险」标签。
不要把「未检索到负面信息」写成「无风险」。
不要因为名字相似就把不同法人当成同一主体（如 PETROKEMYA 与 Jubail United）。
